title: 日本の銀行業の新たな地図
executive_summary: The Japanese banking sector is undergoing significant changes driven by digital infrastructure, M&A expansion, and increased competition for deposits. These shifts are transforming the traditional deposit-and-lending model, with banks evolving into advisors, wealth platforms, and digital infrastructure providers.

investment_themes: Shift from traditional banking to advisory services
Importance of digital infrastructure in financial services
asset_allocation_views: Overweight on Japanese banks with strong digital capabilities
Underweight on banks with weak M&A strategies
risk_assessments: Regulatory risks associated with digital asset adoption
Competition risks from fintech and digital platforms
profile_data.market_outlook: The Japanese financial sector is poised for significant changes, with banks that adapt to the new landscape likely to outperform. The market is expected to favor institutions with strong digital capabilities, M&A expertise, and adaptability in a changing interest rate environment.
